prompt:
Architectural floor plan of one room, drawn straight from above as a clean top-down orthographic plan view in the style of a set designer's ground plan: white background, thick dark walls with gaps for doors and windows, door swings drawn as arcs, windows as thin double lines, and every piece of furniture as a simple outline from above, to scale. In the plan, its bottom edge is the front wall, its top edge the back wall, its left edge the left wall and its right edge the right wall, as the establishing view names them. Draw only the doors, windows and openings the description names. Location: JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE. Upscale downtown apartment lobby landing on Ji Ran's floor at night. Brushed-steel elevator doors stand opposite a heavy walnut front door with a smart lock. The floor is polished stone, and a framed autumn landscape painting in amber tones hangs on the wall. Warm ceiling downlights fall from above, a soft wall sconce glows beside the painting and cooler light spills from the elevator when it opens.

Avoid: people, text, labels, numbers, letters, dimensions, compass, logos, watermark, a door or window the description does not name.
